    ExportJsonToLocalFileJsonObject Method

    Exports a JSON object to a file.

    Definition

    Namespace: Du.DuJson
    Assembly: Du (in Du.dll) Version: 1.0.0+f2741b3d82645b48f42df17c191892e54bdf48c4
    C#
    public static void ToLocalFile<JsonObject>(
	JsonObject jsonObject,
	string filePath,
	bool prettyJson = true
)

    Parameters

    jsonObject  JsonObject
    The JSON object to export.
    filePath  String
    The file path to export the JSON object to.
    prettyJson  Boolean  (Optional)
    Determines if the JSON data is formatted.

    Type Parameters

    JsonObject
    The type of the JSON object.

    Example

    C#
    var myObject = new MyObject();
Du.DuJson.ExportJson.ToLocalFile<MyObject>(myObject, @"C:\Path\to\file.json");        // formatted
Du.DuJson.ExportJson.ToLocalFile<MyObject>(myObject, @"C:\Path\to\file.json", false); // not formatted
